description: This Java source file defines the SingleNoteWidgetConfigurationActivity class, which extends MainActivity. It handles the configuration of a single note widget in the Android app, including setting up the UI, handling note selection, and updating the widget data.

classes.name: SingleNoteWidgetConfigurationActivity
classes.description: An activity class for configuring a single note widget, allowing the user to select a note and update the widget accordingly.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up exception handling, UI elements, and disables refresh layout.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the options menu; here it simply returns true.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles the event when a note is clicked; updates the widget data and broadcasts the update.
